name: tracekit-tutorial
description: Remotion project for the tracekit tutorial video and README stills.

scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i out/frames/element-%04d.png -vf scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 -color_range tv -movflags +faststart ../media/tutorial.mp4
scripts.render:video: npm run render:frames && npm run encode
scripts.render:stills: remotion still src/index.ts Hero ../media/hero.png && remotion still src/index.ts Clustering ../media/clustering.png
